Passed 2025-06-10. Reading generated by ollama:deepseek-v4-pro from the enrolled text; the full text is at the foot of this page so every statement can be checked against it. LegiScan record · official text

What it does

This law requires a person using an artificial intelligence chatbot or other computer technology to engage in trade and commerce with a consumer to notify the consumer in a clear and conspicuous manner that the consumer is not engaging with a human being, if the use may mislead or deceive a reasonable consumer into believing otherwise. A violation is treated as a violation of the Maine Unfair Trade Practices Act.

Who it applies to

  • Any person using an artificial intelligence chatbot or any other computer technology to engage in trade and commerce with a consumer (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2)

Effective date

not stated in the text

Key definitions

  • Artificial intelligence chatbot: a software application, web interface or computer program that simulates human conversation and interaction through textual or aural communications (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 1, paragraph A)
  • Trade and commerce: have the same meaning as in Title 5, section 206, subsection 3 (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 1, paragraph B)

Obligations

  • A person using an artificial intelligence chatbot or any other computer technology to engage in trade and commerce with a consumer in a manner that may mislead or deceive a reasonable consumer into believing that the consumer is engaging with a human being must notify the consumer in a clear and conspicuous manner that the consumer is not engaging with a human being (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2)

Prohibitions

  • A person may not use an artificial intelligence chatbot or any other computer technology to engage in trade and commerce with a consumer in a manner that may mislead or deceive a reasonable consumer into believing that the consumer is engaging with a human being unless the consumer is notified in a clear and conspicuous manner that the consumer is not engaging with a human being (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2)

Penalties and enforcement

A violation of subsection 2 is a violation of the Maine Unfair Trade Practices Act. The text does not state specific enforcement authority, penalties, or whether there is a private right of action beyond that reference (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 3).

How it affects AI deployment

  • An organisation deploying an artificial intelligence chatbot or other computer technology for consumer transactions must provide a clear and conspicuous disclosure that the consumer is not engaging with a human being whenever the interaction may mislead or deceive a reasonable consumer (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2).
  • Failure to provide that disclosure constitutes a violation of the Maine Unfair Trade Practices Act, exposing the organisation to whatever remedies that act provides (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 3).

Notable exemptions

  • not stated in the text

Compliance steps

  • Determine whether the organisation uses an artificial intelligence chatbot or any other computer technology to engage in trade and commerce with consumers (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2).
  • Assess whether that use may mislead or deceive a reasonable consumer into believing that the consumer is engaging with a human being (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2).
  • If so, provide notification to the consumer in a clear and conspicuous manner that the consumer is not engaging with a human being (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2).
  • Ensure the notification is clear and conspicuous as required by the statute (Sec. 1, 10 MRSA §1500-Y, subsec. 2).

 An Act to Ensure Transparency in Consumer Transactions Involving

Be it enacted by the People of the State of Maine as follows:
 Sec. 1. 10 MRSA c. 239 is enacted to read:

 CHAPTER 239

COMMUNICATIONS WITH CONSUMERS VIA ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

§1500-Y. Required disclosure of use of artificial intelligence chatbot to engage in trade
 and commerce
 1. Definitions. As used in this section, unless the context otherwise indicates, the
following terms have the following meanings.
 A. "Artificial intelligence chatbot" means a software application, web interface or
 computer program that simulates human conversation and interaction through textual
 or aural communications.
 B. "Trade" and "commerce" have the same meaning as in Title 5, section 206,
 subsection 3.
 2. Required disclosure of use of artificial intelligence chatbot to engage in trade
and commerce. A person may not use an artificial intelligence chatbot or any other
computer technology to engage in trade and commerce with a consumer in a manner that
may mislead or deceive a reasonable consumer into believing that the consumer is engaging
with a human being unless the consumer is notified in a clear and conspicuous manner that
the consumer is not engaging with a human being.
 3. Violation. A violation of subsection 2 is a violation of the Maine Unfair Trade
Practices Act.
